prs.body:
## High Level Overview of Change

This PR addresses #4684 issue. This is the payment engine breaking change and requires an amendment.

### Context of Change

flowCross amendment introduces an issue where the offer crossing with tfFillOrKill flag set and tfSell not set fails to cross an offer with a better rate. For instance, given two offers:
(takerPays/takerGets)
XRP(100)/USD(100)
USD(100)/XRP(101) has tfFillOrKill set
The second offer fails to cross but it should succeed because the taker can buy USD(100) for XRP(100) instead of XRP(101). XRPL reference for the [offer create with tfFillOrKill](https://xrpl.org/offercreate.html) states: 
>    ...the owner must receive the full TakerPays amount; if the tfSell flag is enabled, the owner must be able to spend the entire TakerGets amount instead.

### Type of Change

- [ x] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [x ] Tests (You added tests for code that already exists, or your new feature included in this PR)

## Before / After

The amendment code added in StrandFlow.cpp:flow() handles tfFillOrKill and tfFillOrKill+tfSell as two separate cases, whereas the original code handled both as one case.

## Test Plan

Added testFillOrKill() to Offer_test.

issues.title: Create trust line if not present on Create FillOrKill Offer (Version: 1.9.1)
issues.author: elmurci
issues.body:
## Issue Description

When creating an offer where the trust line to the issuer is not set yet, the trust line is created in the same step if the offer is successful and matches to another existing offer.

When the `tfFillOrKill` flag is applied in the same scenario, the transaction fails with a `tecKILLED` code.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Post a "sell" offer from a `non-issuing wallet 1` of `10 A.issuer` in exchange for `100 B.issuer`
2. Post a FillOrKill "buy" offer from a `non-issuing wallet 2` with no trust lines set to the issuer of `100 B.issuer` in exchange for `10 B.issuer` 
3. Transaction fails with `tecKILLED`.

## Expected Result

I would expect the same behaviour as when it is not a FillOrKill offer, that is, create the trust line to the issuer on Create Offer.

## Actual Result

The transaction fails with `tecKILLED`.

## Environment

Testnet

issues.title: Return tecKILLED instead of tesSUCCESS when FillOrKill kills
issues.author: mDuo13
issues.body:
Change the OfferCreate transactor so that, when an offer with tfFillOrKill enabled cannot be filled, it returns a new error code (tecKILLED) instead of returning tesSUCCESS without filling the offer. ([As requested on XRPChat.](https://www.xrpchat.com/topic/15174-fillorkill-flag-not-working/))

Similar to the tecEXPIRED change, this change would make it much easier to know when an OfferCreate with tfFillOrKill was killed because it couldn't be filled. As it stands, if the metadata doesn't indicate the offer is filled, you have to infer that it was because the offer was killed, and not because of something else (for example, the past-expiration thing).
